one_liner_zh: 亞馬遜公司（AMZN）最新季度財報超出預期，EPS達2.78美元，創下69.02%的驚喜
one_liner_en: Amazon.com, Inc. (AMZN) reported better-than-expected quarterly earnings with an EPS of $2.78, beating estimates by 69.02%
beat_or_miss: 超預期，主要歸因於強勁的收入增長和成本控制
highlights_zh: 收入達181.52億美元，同比增長16.61%
公司的雲端計算和廣告業務表現出色
highlights_en: The company's cloud computing and advertising businesses performed well
risks_zh: 全球經濟不確定性可能影響消費者支出
競爭加劇可能對公司的市場份額產生負面影響
risks_en: Global economic uncertainty may impact consumer spending
Increasing competition may negatively affect the company's market share
ai_view_zh: 亞馬遜公司的財報超出預期，顯示公司的業務仍然強勁，尤其是在雲端計算和廣告領域。然而，全球經濟不確定性和競爭加劇仍是需要關注的風險，投資者應追蹤公司的收入增長和成本控制情況
ai_view_en: The better-than-expected earnings report from Amazon.com, Inc. indicates the company's business remains strong, particularly in cloud computing and advertising. However, global economic uncertainty and increasing competition are risks that need to be monitored, and investors should track the company's revenue growth and cost control
